title: ENA Dream BBQ Totem
description: This resource pack changes the texture of the totem to the character "ENA" from the game "ENA Dream BBQ"
body:
![visual](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a59527c7fc1ca356de4c2a2b971cd6378574d124.jpeg)
# About the resource pack:

This resource pack changes the texture of the totem to a pixel image of the character "ENA" from the game "ENA Dream BBQ" and will likely appeal to fans of this game. The sound of the totem has also been changed.

# Note:

Please do not install this resource pack simultaneously with other similar ones to avoid conflicts.
